title: Threads Scraper — Search, Posts, Profiles, Replies & Feeds

feedUrls.title: Feed URLs
feedUrls.description: Threads custom feed URLs (e.g. https://www.threads.com/custom_feed/18113589370710265). Optional if searchKeywords or searchTags are provided.

searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords
searchKeywords.description: Keywords to search on Threads (e.g. "寵物醫療", "AI news"). Results come from threads.com/search.

searchTags.title: Tags / Topics
searchTags.description: Hashtags or topics to search on Threads (e.g. "#寵物友善", "tech"). Leading # is optional.

maxPosts.title: Max Posts
maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to scrape per source

scrollCount.title: Scroll Count
scrollCount.description: Number of times to scroll down to load more posts

profileUrls.title: Profile URLs
profileUrls.description: Threads profile URLs to scrape posts from (e.g. https://www.threads.com/@zuck). Leading @ is optional.

postUrls.title: Post URLs
postUrls.description: Individual Threads post URLs to scrape with replies (e.g. https://www.threads.com/@user/post/ABC123).

searchSort.title: Search Sort
searchSort.description: Sort order for search results. Only applies to searchKeywords.

dateFrom.title: Date From
dateFrom.description: Filter posts from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Posts before this date are excluded.

dateTo.title: Date To
dateTo.description: Filter posts until this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Posts after this date are excluded.
